notes:
Route found 2026-10-27, ~31 requests, 16 s, 8333 unique URLs, all 31 days covered.

Probes: robots.txt https://www.hamshahrionline.ir/robots.txt -> 200, permissive (only '# Disallow: /print/' is commented out), and it lists Sitemap: /sitemap/news/sitemap.xml, /sitemap/all/sitemap.xml and one index per Jalali year (/sitemap/1405/sitemap.xml ... back to 1385). /sitemap/news/sitemap.xml (200) is a Google-News-style urlset but holds only 100 items covering ~12 h (2026-10-26 19:30 .. 2026-10-27 07:03) - too short for a month window, not used. /sitemap/1405/sitemap.xml (200) is a sitemapindex of PER-DAY files /sitemap/1405/MM/DD/sitemap.xml in the Jalali calendar (index newest entry 1405/08/05 = today). Day file /sitemap/1405/07/05/sitemap.xml (200, 49 KB) is served as JSON, not XML: {"urls":[{"loc":...,"lastmode":"2026-09-27T19:59:29Z",...}]} - so the parser accepts JSON and falls back to <url>/<loc>/<lastmod> XML if the server ever switches back.

Window mapping: Jalali 1405 starts 2026-03-21, so 2026-09-25 = 1405/07/03 and 2026-10-25 = 1405/08/03; the script converts each Gregorian day of the window with a g2j() implementation and fetches exactly those 31 day files, no recursion and no index scan.

Date: 'lastmode' (their spelling) is the publish instant in Tehran local time labelled Z. It equals the article page JSON-LD "datePublished" to the second on 4 re-fetched samples (2026-10-14T18:18:32Z, 2026-10-05T11:45:00Z, 2026-10-19T10:35:23Z, 2026-09-28T07:12:19Z), so the listed date is lastmode's date part, filtered to the window.

TRAP that killed the previous attempt (all 6 samples status 0, 0 chars): the sitemap <loc> values carry RAW Persian characters in the slug (e.g. /news/1072250/هرمز-تخلیه-شد). urllib cannot send a non-ASCII URL and raises, which polite_fetch reports as status 0 with an empty body. The script percent-encodes every URL (urllib.parse.quote on path, preserving /%:@&=+$,~-._) before writing it, and the same percent-encoded URLs re-fetch 200 with 6.7k-9.1k chars of text - 4/4 samples good, page date == listed date exactly.

Counts: 2026-09-30 = 279, 2026-10-10 = 329, 2026-10-20 = 369 (min over the window 94 on 2026-10-01, Fridays low), so no low_volume flag needed. No robots-disallowed path was used; every request went through polite_fetch.
